name: Automation
description: How much recurring execution can run without owner intervention.

name: Owner-time efficiency
description: How little recurring owner time is required relative to value produced.

name: Launch speed
description: How quickly a credible first test/offer can be launched.

name: Capital efficiency
description: How little upfront/working capital is required.

name: Contribution economics
description: Expected contribution potential after direct variable costs.

name: Demand signal
description: Strength and quality of evidence that buyers want/pay for the outcome.

name: Competition gap
description: Room for a differentiated entrant after substitutes/competition.

name: Acquisition efficiency
description: Ability to reach buyers without excessive cost or owner effort.

name: Platform resilience
description: Resistance to a single marketplace/platform dependency.

name: Defensibility
description: Potential for durable differentiation, data, audience, brand, workflow or other compounding advantage.

name: Scale without hiring
description: Ability to grow revenue without proportional human headcount.

name: Supply-demand match quality
description: Evidence-backed aggregate quality of evaluated non-self supplier-buyer requirement matches; preserves candidate coverage and disposition counts.
